architect

A Winchester architect, he seems to have disagreed with CMY about the extent to which O. B.

Carter, rather than WCY, was responsible for the design of the church of St.

Matthew, Otterbourne.

See Brenda Poole, John Colson: A Hampshire Architect of the Victorian Age (Winchester: Hampshire Record Office 2000).
